newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Demirbank gets $40 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Turk Demirbank gets $40 mln loan.

text.p: Turkey's medium-scale commercial bank Demirbank said it secured a $40 million, long-term loan from a consortium led by the World Bank affiliate International Finance Corporation (IFC).
Dutch finance institution FMO, Dai Ichi Kangyo Bank and Sakura Bank also participated in the loan deal, the bank said in a statement it sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
It said $10 million of the loan package had 10-year maturity and the rest had 6-1/2 year maturity. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 0875.
